panels.title: 資料多久沒更新（台灣測站）
panels.description: 測站每小時發布一次；超過 3 小時（紅色）會觸發 AqiStationDataStale 告警。

panels.title: AQI 趨勢

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS time, device_id AS metric, CASE WHEN aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN aqi::float END AS value FROM aqi4_info WHERE $__timeFilter(time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') ORDER BY 1

panels.description: DAG 只保留 3 天的資料。

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS time, device_id AS metric, CASE WHEN pm2_5 ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN pm2_5::float END AS value FROM aqi4_info WHERE $__timeFilter(time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') ORDER BY 1
SELECT time, device_id AS 測站, aqi, pm2_5, pm10, o3, co, so2, no2 FROM aqi4_info ORDER BY time DESC, device_id LIMIT 30

panels.title: 照片推論 vs 環境部實際值（DAG aqi_image_predict，每小時 :20）

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.sitename AS 測站, p.image_time AS 照片時間, p.pred_label AS 預測, a.aqi AS 實際AQI, (ARRAY['Good','Moderate','USG','Unhealthy','Very Unhealthy','Severe'])[(CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) + 1] AS 實際等級, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) IS NULL THEN '尚無實際值' WHEN (CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) = p.pred_class THEN '相符' ELSE '不符' END AS 結果, p.rh, p.temperature, p.ws_hr, p.model_version AS 模型版本, p.image_key AS MinIO檔案 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (sitename) * FROM aqi_prediction ORDER BY sitename, image_time DESC) p LEFT JOIN aqi4_info a ON a.device_id = p.sitename AND a.time = date_trunc('hour', p.image_time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 預測準確率（所選時間範圍）

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) = p.pred_class THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS 準確率, count(*) AS 筆數 FROM aqi_prediction p LEFT JOIN aqi4_info a ON a.device_id = p.sitename AND a.time = date_trunc('hour', p.image_time) WHERE p.model_version <> 'legacy' AND (CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(p.image_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')

panels.description: 預測等級和照片拍攝那一小時環境部公布的 AQI 等級相同的比例。

panels.title: 預測等級 vs 實際等級（0 Good … 5 Severe）

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.image_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS time, p.sitename || ' 預測' AS metric, p.pred_class AS value FROM aqi_prediction p WHERE p.model_version <> 'legacy' AND $__timeFilter(p.image_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') UNION ALL SELECT a.time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', a.device_id || ' 實際', CASE WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 50 THEN 0 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 100 THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 150 THEN 2 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 200 THEN 3 WHEN CASE WHEN a.aqi ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN a.aqi::float END <= 300 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END FROM aqi4_info a WHERE a.device_id IN ('基隆','林口','嘉義','安南') AND $__timeFilter(a.time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') ORDER BY 1
